description: This file defines an interface ITaskRepository in C# for task item persistence operations, including methods for fetching all tasks, fetching by ID, adding, updating, deleting, and checking existence.

classes.name: ITaskRepository
classes.description: Repository abstraction interface for TaskItem entity, providing asynchronous methods for CRUD operations and existence check.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a TaskItem by its unique identifier asynchronously.

methods.name: ExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks asynchronously whether a TaskItem exists by its ID.
